message.content: Show the inline markers a reply carries.

## Inline markers

The reply sets **bold weight**, _italic slant_ and `inline_code()` in one line of prose.

A reference reads [the handbook](https://veyyon.dev/docs) and a frame reads
![the capture](https://veyyon.dev/frame.png).

An identifier keeps its underscores: call read_file_ at the boundary.

- a list item carrying **bold** and `code`
- a second item carrying _slant_ and [a link](https://veyyon.dev)
